g.text: Current behavior: no command class accepts a
durable-yield suspension, so this wait has no
resume transition. Only run-level cancel or
migrate can act on the run. Tracked as a known
An empty approver set admits any ledger-authorized
actor. Each actor decides at most once and every
decisionId is globally unique. The approval deadline
(from the node timeout policy) is recorded and
published as the run's due_at but is not auto-enforced:
no timedOut disposition fires, and the recovery scan
reports an error until the approval resolves.
